## What LeadBoosterX does

LeadBoosterX sets up, fixes and runs GoHighLevel (HighLevel CRM, often shortened to GHL) so every lead is captured, followed up automatically, and moved to a booked call or a closed sale. No long-term contract.

Most leads are not lost to bad marketing. They leak at one of three stages:

- Capture — leads scattered everywhere. Leads come in from forms, calls, messages and ads, and land in different inboxes. Some are never seen.
- Nurture — follow-up that never happens. Most leads don't book on the first message. Without automatic follow-up, warm leads go cold.
- Close — booked, then forgotten. No reminder, no follow-up, no payment link, no sale.

The fix is one connected system inside GoHighLevel, where each stage hands the lead to the next:

- Capture: every lead lands in one place (funnels, forms, chat widget, missed-call text-back).
- Nurture: every lead gets followed up automatically (pipelines, SMS and email sequences, reminders).
- Close: every booked call has a clear path to the sale (calendars, no-show recovery, payment links, review requests).

## How a build works

1. Audit and plan: map how leads come in, how they're followed up and how deals close today, and what to build first.
2. Build: Capture, Nurture and Close set up in the client's own GoHighLevel account.
3. Test and go live: every form, workflow, calendar and reminder is tested end to end, then switched on.
4. Manage (optional): monthly management keeps it running, with a plain-English report.

Everything is built in the client's own GoHighLevel account, so the client keeps every funnel, workflow and contact. No long-term contracts; monthly management is month-to-month.

## Packages

Pricing depends on the setup and is scoped on a free call.

### Single-Stage Build
Fix the stage that's leaking most. For businesses already on GoHighLevel with one weak spot.
- Audit of the current GoHighLevel setup
- Rebuild of one stage: Capture, Nurture or Close
- Repair of broken workflows and triggers in that stage
- Every path in that stage tested before launch

### Complete Capture → Nurture → Close System (recommended)
All three stages, built and connected. For businesses that want GoHighLevel working end to end — new to GHL or rebuilding.
- Capture: funnels, forms, chat widget and missed-call text-back
- Nurture: pipelines, SMS and email sequences, reminders
- Close: calendars, no-show recovery, payment links, review requests
- Contacts and pipelines moved from the old CRM
- Every path tested end to end before launch

### GoHighLevel Management (month-to-month)
Keep it running and keep it improving. Ongoing support after the system is live.
- Workflow and automation upkeep
- New funnels, forms and campaigns as needed
- Pipeline and reporting tune-ups
- Plain-English monthly report

- Dedicated GoHighLevel VA: a dedicated GoHighLevel admin for one business or agency (day-to-day account management; builds inside agency client accounts — workflows, funnels, pipelines and snapshots; documented hand-offs).
- Project-Based GoHighLevel Freelancer: one-time builds, fixes and migrations (the Complete Capture → Nurture → Close System, a fix of the stage that's leaking most, contacts and pipelines moved from another CRM, or a single funnel, pipeline or follow-up automation).

Skills: funnels and websites (including AI Studio), forms and surveys, workflows and automations, pipelines and opportunities, SMS and email follow-up, calendars and booking, no-show recovery, payment links and failed-payment recovery, review requests, missed-call text-back and chat widget, CRM migration to GoHighLevel, agency client accounts and snapshots, AI chat and voice assistants.

Pricing is scoped on a free call; no long-term contract.

## Projects

- Freight Quote System (demo build): a landing page made in GoHighLevel AI Studio with a video hero and a quote form; every request becomes a tagged contact and a new deal. Nurture: an instant email and text, then timed follow-ups until a quote call is booked. Close: the booked call moves the deal forward and stops the follow-ups, then ends in a thank-you and review request, or a final offer before the deal is marked lost.
- Upholstery Shop Quote System (demo build): a site with the quote form in the hero; Nurture and Close workflows follow up with an email, a text and a consultation invite, then move the deal to won or lost.
- Tree Service Estimate System (demo build): a short estimate form, service cards and an emergency storm call to action; Nurture and Close workflows follow up with an email, a text and a site-visit invite, then move the deal to won or lost.
- Payment Recovery Pipeline (real build, client details redacted): for a membership business, a failed Stripe payment opens a pipeline opportunity, alerts the team, and moves through stages (contacted, no answer, voicemail, callback, payment link sent, recovered or cancelled) as call outcomes are logged.

The demo builds were made in a GoHighLevel test account to show the approach; they are not client projects.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What kinds of businesses do you work with?
A: Any business that runs on GoHighLevel — or is moving to it: service businesses, coaches and online programs, home services, and agencies that need a builder for client accounts. If you sell through calls, consultations or estimates, the system fits well.

Q: What do you actually do?
A: I build and run GoHighLevel as one connected system. Capture: funnels, forms, chat and missed-call text-back. Nurture: pipelines, SMS and email follow-up, and reminders. Close: calendars, no-show recovery, payment links and review requests. There are three packages: the Complete Capture → Nurture → Close System, a Single-Stage Build, and monthly GoHighLevel Management.

Q: Do I need my own GoHighLevel account?
A: Yes. Everything is built in your own account, so you own it and keep it. If you don't have one yet, we'll set it up together at the start.

Q: Can you move my contacts from another CRM?
A: Yes. Contacts, tags and pipeline stages can be imported from your current CRM or a spreadsheet as part of the build.

Q: Can you fix my existing GoHighLevel account?
A: Yes. That's what the Single-Stage Build is for: I audit your setup, then rebuild the stage that's leaking most — Capture, Nurture or Close.

Q: Do you work with agencies?
A: Yes. I build inside agency client accounts — workflows, funnels, pipelines and snapshots — and hand them back documented.

Q: What does it cost?
A: It depends on your setup — how many offers you run, whether you already have ads and a CRM, and which package fits. I'll scope it on the free call and send a clear quote before any work starts.

Q: What do I need to provide?
A: Access to your ad account, CRM and calendar, the details of your offer, and any photos, videos or testimonials you want to use. I'll send a short checklist once we agree to work together.

Q: Do I need to sign a long-term contract?
A: No. The build is a one-time project, and monthly management is month-to-month. You can stop anytime.

Q: Do you only generate leads?
A: No. Leads are only the start. I focus just as much on what happens next — fast response, qualification, booking, reminders, and follow-up — because that's where most revenue is won or lost.

Q: Can you set up an AI receptionist for my business?
A: Yes. I set up AI chat and voice assistants that answer common questions, ask qualifying questions, and book calls into your calendar, with a handoff to your team when a person needs to step in.

Q: Do you work with clients outside the Philippines?
A: Yes. I'm based in the Philippines and work remotely with clients in the US and elsewhere. I adjust my hours to overlap with your business day.

Q: Do you take one-off projects?
A: Yes. I take one-time builds — like a funnel, a pipeline, or a follow-up automation — as well as ongoing monthly GoHighLevel management.

Q: How do we get started?
A: Book a free strategy call. We'll look at how leads come in today, where they're slipping through, and what to build first. You'll leave with a clear next step, whether or not we work together.
